name: SunPad
notes: Empty app plus the decompilation engine PadMint builds on the player's Mac with Homebrew LLVM; the disc is chosen in the app. The legacy translated-module entry is kept in SunPad's docs/legacy/padmint-catalog-sunpad.json.

steps: Open SunPad and choose your own Super Mario Sunshine (USA, GMSE01, revision 0) .iso in Files: ••• → Game Data → Import or Reimport Game Data. SunPad checks it and keeps a private copy.
Updating from SunPad 0.3? Install over the existing app with the same signing setup. Your saves carry over on first launch, and the old save files stay as they were.
